reasons.plausibility: It matches existing knowledge on passive film formation in multicomponent alloys, although the specific self-healing aspect at grain boundaries awaits deeper validation.
reasons.testability: Its clear comparison of two well-defined alloy sets under identical combined wear-corrosion tests provides a direct and feasible route to validate or falsify the self-healing film mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: This approach targets a critical challenge in improving high-entropy alloys for harsh environments and offers a concrete methodology to guide alloy design.
